text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I open the "textbook" and face the blank 
page.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If only I had a guiding principle for what 
the 'Legendary Umamusume' would have done 
in this exact situation...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Could she have been spared from making 
that kind of expression?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...My pen moves. Filling in the textbook 
page by page.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely help her." "Help her." 
"Make her strong." "Make her truly 
strong."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—No. Merely having determination won't 
solve this. What she needs is—...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What is truly needed is...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"The reason I decided to do this 
interview... is because I wanted to 
change."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: "Change... you say?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Last year, I was desperate. 
...Desperate not to be trampled underfoot. 
Not to be crushed by the Central Tracen."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"And I directed nothing but hatred toward 
my opponent. ...With every defeat, that 
feeling only grew stronger."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
""However, the Umamusume carrying the 
weight of the JRA was different.""

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"She found the cause of her own weakness 
within herself. That was... the difference 
between her and me."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I reflected on it. I decided to change. 
...So that I can truly stand alongside 
them."

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Furioso, you did great...!" "You've grown 
so much...!" "Let's keep growing together! 
Hand in hand with Funabashi!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...H-Haha. Stop it, like that's... that's—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
That's not right, is it... Furioso? 
You're... different...—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Whaaat—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Furioso-san, you can do it! Please grow 
strong for all our sakes!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
600 left, I'm joining in too! That's where 
Furioso's weak point is... right?!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—...gh, thank you so much, Senpai! Going 
out of your way just for me...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me what I am lacking. ...I 
swear I will overcome it all!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
What the hell are you doing, Furioso? 
You're—you're supposed to be—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Furioso!!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Furioso... Who is that 
girl...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Um, an acquaintance from the URA, and...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Haa... phew... Espo-san, why are you at 
Funabashi—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: What are you doing, Furioso?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"You ain't weak, are you?! You're not the 
kind of person who begs for help, are 
you?!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You're a strong Umamusume, and...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Espo-san.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "Please calm down. I am—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Don't say it!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Furioso, you're different!! Stand proud, 
you're strong! 'Cause you're—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
――"Acting tough" is not the same as truly 
becoming strong.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Even after the Teio Sho, I continued to 
compete in dirt races."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yet the more I ran, the further victory 
slipped from my grasp.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...I was frustrated, you know. Losing over 
and over again. And then—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—On that day, I realized that my own 
distortion was the reason for my defeat.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Standing before that person's strength—the 
way they face themselves head-on and 
always reach for the top.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I learned that there are places you cannot 
reach on frustration alone.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"And so I made up my mind. Even if it 
means exposing my unpolished self before 
my beloved Funabashi... —I will become 
strong."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Stop...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...St—stop it...! Don't treat me like all 
the others...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
My friends are waiting for me. ...Excuse 
me.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Furioso...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...I intend to enter the Kashiwa Kinen 
this year."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
To run in that race held at Funabashi, as 
Funabashi's representative.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
If you want to deny "my way of doing 
things"... then all you have to do is 
defeat me out there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving my frozen self behind, time 
marches on mercilessly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, I couldn't write anything 
in the notebook. I couldn't find any... 
answers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A "strongest Umamusume" who could guide 
her right now, who could protect her...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Did the 'Legendary Umamusume' also ask 
someone for help and grow stronger with 
their support?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Did even the "Legendary Umamusume" show a 
sign of weakness...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her arms drop limply to her sides. A 
lonely shadow stretches out along the 
ground.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know the answer. I want to know 
the answer. Yet for now, all I could do 
was make them wait.
